svg.title: L2 contains two parallel mechanisms: drive broadcast and reflex arc
svg.desc: Inside L2, status and background signals feed the slow broadcast path which produces ambient state read by L3. Threat signals feed the parallel reflex arc path which executes directly without L3.

g.text: suppression asymmetry: L3 can dampen drive-broadcast effects (defer curiosity in high survival),
but cannot stop L0/L1 reflex arc (heartbeat-first, instance_invalid yield).
this is what makes "reflex" structural rather than policy — it cannot be reasoned away.
